description: Kerala renames IT department to reflect AI and future technologies, aligning governance with global tech priorities and startup growth.
body_lead: The State government has renamed the Electronics & Information Technology (IT) department as the Department of Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Future Technologies to align the State’s technology governance with emerging global priorities. The change follows the announcement made in the Governor’s policy address for 2026 regarding the repositioning of the department in line with the State’s technology vision. The decision reflects the expansion of the department’s mandate beyond conventional Information Technology and electronics.
